structural_change: k7 (H-SU 2026-10-16): k6 hbm_sfucore_split-k6-dea957e63 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN bank_distance (lanes 0/3/6/12.. 502 um from their E-face pins: only one lane column can sit within 100 um of one face) + TEXTBOOK REFUSE clk 18,143 sinks / rst_n 13,745 loads. Fix: ot_hgi_sfu_core_split2 splits the lane-direct buses W (lanes 0-7) / E (8-15) so each lane column hugs its own face; pin regs on their own roots clk_pw (W ~4.4k) / clk_pe (E ~2.7k), clk keeps bridge+engine (~10.9k); rst_n -> ot_rst_relay (4 regions). Floorplan: lane columns R0 W / MY E at 32.4 um from the faces, 352.08 pitch (21.6 um row gaps), 80 SRAMs abutted in the middle column (x 295.488), local_* W and io/ctl E moved above the lane field (2838.8..3560). Same outline 763.56 x 3580. | k8 (H-SU 1815 fork, 10-16): d4c SU/VM band <= 3.30 mm (die <= 25.2 mm, portrait SM rows): k7 763.56 x 3580 was taller than the band. Re-aspect only (same RTL ot_hgi_sfu_core_split2, same clock roots / reset relays / benches): outline 950.4 x 3132; lane columns W (0-7, R0) / E (8-15, MY) 32.4 um from their faces at 393.12 pitch (62.64 um row gaps = horizontal corridors); the 80 operand SRAMs fold from one 3,283 um column into two columns of 40 with a 21.9 um middle channel (W column x 291.456 MY, pins facing the 43 um W channel; E column x 486.144 R0, pins facing the 43 um E channel; y 745.2..2386.8); local_* (4,448) now share the W face and io_word/compiler_control (2,214) the E face with the lane buses over the full 23.76..3108.24 span (W ~1.9 pins/um, E ~1.1 pins/um, <= 6/um), no pin region above the lane field. Reset (owner standard 10-16, binding): OT_SFU_SYNC_RST makes every reset in the core files synchronous (bridge, engine, operand store, bcast tree, static quarter, core); rst_n drives only ot_rst_relay (2 sync + 1 tree stage, 4 regional registered copies); the W/E boundary pin registers (local_*, io/ctl, ro_*) carry no reset (pure data stages). Lane hard child ot_su12_sfu unchanged (closed view). d4f (ce21ef609 grants_d4f sfucore_* slot 950.4 x 3132, clock_entry clk N M5 offset 381.78, faces W band / E COLL-DBK / N clock+reset / S band channel): clk, rst_n, clk_pw, clk_pe, clk_lg, rst_lg_n moved to the N face at x 378.5..404.5 (above the W SRAM column, free logic region); per-lane clk_lane/clk_map/rst_lane_n/rst_map_n stay on W beside their lanes.
